basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old student from Austin, Texas, currently studying computer science. I have a keen interest in video games and love exploring new gaming concepts, which is how I stumbled upon Reddit. I enjoy crafting and have recently started learning about haircare routines. I dislike overly complex game mechanics. I typically browse Reddit during the evenings between 8-11 PM after my classes. I'm currently single and spend my weekends either gaming or experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily revolves around video games, which I've been passionate about since my early teens. I've picked up a lot through self-teaching and online courses related to game development and programming. Recently, I've also been learning about personal care through various online platforms.
